title: fix(plugin-approvals): the data door serves an approval request's flow and step labels in the reader's language
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X27DRismkrd3QfL8JeFsGMQ)_

Fixes #27041

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：通过通用数据接口读 `sys_approval_request`（Setup › 审批申请列表、申请的记录页、查找字段的标题、导出）时，流程名 `process_label` 和步骤名 `current_step_label` 按读者语言返回，用的就是审批接口（`/api/v1/approvals/requests`）已有的那一套查找；语言包没有的条目照旧返回存储文本。
- **为什么改**：zh-CN 用户在审批收件箱看到中文，在 Setup › 审批申请里看到同一批申请却是英文（HotCRM 的 "Large Deal Approval" / "Sales Manager Review"）。收件箱那一半由控制台 PR #27040 修了，列表这一半只能在服务端修。
- **风险与回滚**：低。只改读出的行，存储不动；系统上下文读取、无语言、语言包无条目都返回原文。列表按列 `$select` 时会临时多取 `process_name` / `current_step` 用来拼键，返回前删掉，调用方拿到的列不变。回滚即 revert。
- **先看**：`packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/reader-locale-labels-middleware.ts`（借列与剥列、系统读跳过）；`approvals-plugin.ts` 的注册位置（与读门同处，不在 `disableAutoHooks` 后面）；`content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx` 第 17 行。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals exec vitest run src/reader-locale-labels-data-door.integration.test.ts`，预期 10/10 通过；或启动 showcase 后用 `Accept-Language: zh-CN` 请求 `GET /api/v1/data/sys_approval_request?$select=process_label,current_step_label`，看到「发票双重签批（并行审批）」等中文。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`@objectstack/plugin-approvals` registers one more engine middleware on `sys_approval_request`, `bindReaderLocaleLabelsMiddleware` (new file `reader-locale-labels-middleware.ts`), beside the snapshot redaction (`payload-redaction-middleware.ts`) and for its reason: one registration at the engine covers the whole generic-read family (REST data routes, ObjectQL callers, the CSV/XLSX export, the MCP data tool, the AI-context interceptor), and middleware carries the door's real `ExecutionContext`, whose `locale` is the one the approvals door reads (`Accept-Language`, else the workspace `localization` settings).

- **One lookup.** The labels come from `readerLabelsFor` and are placed by `localizeRequestLabels` (`reader-locale-labels.ts`), the approvals door's own pair. No second translation table, no new key spelling: same keys (`flows.FLOW.label`, `flows.FLOW.approvals.NODE.label`), same locale negotiation (`resolveBundleLocale`), same fallback to the stored text on a miss.
- **Only the columns the read carries.** `process_label` and `current_step_label` are overlaid; `step_label` and `object_label` are approvals-door fields, not columns, and this door does not add them.
- **Projection kept.** Setup's `all_requests` view selects the labels and not the machine columns. When a read selects a label without the column its key is spelled from (`process_name`, `current_step`), the middleware borrows that column into `ast.fields` for the read and deletes it from every row before the rows go back, so the caller is served exactly the columns it asked for.
- **Read-time only.** Storage is untouched. A system read (`isSystem`) is served as stored even when its context carries a locale, so nothing the platform reads back and writes again holds a reader's language. No locale, no `i18n` service, or a missing pack entry: the stored text.
- **Registered always.** Bound beside the generic-door read gate (`bindRequestReadGate`), not behind `disableAutoHooks`, because the approvals door localizes whenever the service runs.
- **Census row.** The new `isSystem` read is named on `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx` row 17 (the plugin-approvals generic-read row) and the generated register is regenerated with `node scripts/check-system-context-census.mjs --write` (claim amendment `6461039298`).
- Docblocks: `reader-locale-labels.ts` no longer says the data door serves the stored text; `sys-approval-request.object.ts` notes the overlay beside the display-column comment.

## Tests

New `reader-locale-labels-data-door.integration.test.ts`: the rig of `reader-locale-display-labels.integration.test.ts` (real `ObjectQL` over `SqlDriver` better-sqlite3, the real `AutomationEngine` opening the request through the real approval node, the real `ApprovalsServicePlugin` over the real in-memory `i18n` service with a zh-CN pack parsed by `TranslationDataSchema`), read through `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation.findData` / `getData`, the calls the REST data routes make.

- zh-CN reader: Setup's list projected to `all_requests`' columns, the full-column list, the by-id read, a bare `zh`: the zh-CN labels.
- The borrowed key columns are not served on the projected list.
- Parity: the same row read through `svc.getRequest` and through the data door (list and by-id) carries equal label text.
- A step the pack does not carry: stored step label beside the translated flow label.
- Fences (green on both sides): ja-JP, en and no locale serve the stored text; a system read with a locale serves the stored text; no `step_label` / `object_label` column is added; the stored row keeps the authored text.

Package: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals test` 105 files / 1331 tests passed; `typecheck` exit 0; `build` exit 0 (on `f7d8e486`; the only later commit, `ee26b793`, touches `system-context.mdx` alone).

## Acceptance notes

- `display_title` (a formula, `process_label` else `process_name`) is computed inside the engine before middleware runs, so it stays the stored text. It is not the title pointer (`nameField: process_label`) and no list view shows it.
- Filter, sort, group and search over `process_label` / `current_step_label` compare the stored text, so a grid grouped by `process_label` heads its groups in the authoring language. Not filed: no reproduction on a shipped view (none groups by these columns).
- `count` / `aggregate` are untouched; they serve no label text.

## Verification

<details><summary>Red first, in-package (base f708cf22 + the test only, commit 36c54057)</summary>

```
× Setup's list, projected to its columns: the labels in zh-CN, and only the columns it selected
× the full-column list: the labels in zh-CN, the machine columns as stored
× the by-id read
× a bare `zh` reaches the zh-CN pack
× parity: the data door and the approvals door serve the same label text for the same row
× a step the pack does not carry is served as stored, beside the flow label it does
- "current_step_label": "经理审核",  - "process_label": "客户审批",
+ "current_step_label": "Manager Review",  + "process_label": "Account Approval",
Tests  6 failed | 4 passed (10)
```

Green on the fix: the new file plus `reader-locale-display-labels.integration.test.ts` and `request-read-gate.integration.test.ts`: 3 files, 36/36 passed.
</details>

<details><summary>Live red/green through the real REST data door (showcase, `pnpm dev -- --fresh`)</summary>

Signed in as the seeded dev admin; the showcase boot opens three pending requests whose flows its zh-CN pack translates. Red = the base blob of `approvals-plugin.ts` written over the file and the package rebuilt (bind count in `dist/index.js` 0); green = HEAD (count 2). Restored by `git checkout HEAD --`, blob `869363ef` equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

`GET /api/v1/data/sys_approval_request?$select=process_label,record_id,status,current_step_label,pending_approver_labels,submitter_id,updated_at`, `Accept-Language: zh-CN`:

| | process_label | current_step_label |
|---|---|---|
| base | Invoice Dual Sign-off (parallel approval) | Finance + Legal Sign-off |
| base | High-Value Expense — Committee Quorum | Committee Sign-off (2 of 3) |
| base | Expense Report Sign-off | Manager + Finance Sign-off |
| head | 发票双重签批（并行审批） | 财务 + 法务签批 |
| head | 大额费用 — 委员会多数签批 | 委员会签批（三分之二） |
| head | 费用报告签批 | 经理 + 财务签批 |

On head, `process_name` / `current_step` absent from those rows; `ja-JP` and `en` serve the English text on both sides.

By id, `zh-CN`: base `GET /data/sys_approval_request/ID` served "Invoice Dual Sign-off (parallel approval)" while `GET /approvals/requests/ID` served "发票双重签批（并行审批）"; head serves "发票双重签批（并行审批）" / "财务 + 法务签批" on both doors. The data door row carries no `step_label` / `object_label`.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (src-resolved suite, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty)</summary>

- A: the `bindReaderLocaleLabelsMiddleware(...)` call in `approvals-plugin.ts` replaced: 6 failed / 4 passed, the six zh-CN pins.
- B: the projection widening disabled in `borrowLabelKeyColumns`: 3 failed (the three projected-list pins).
- C: the borrowed-column strip disabled: 1 failed (the projected list serves `process_name` / `current_step`).
</details>

<details><summary>Gates (head ee26b793)</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 92 families, all run, all exit 0; `--ran` reconciliation: 92 derived, 92 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. First pass reds re-run after the full build settled: `check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:i18n` (each ran against a `dist/` mid-rebuild), `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (shallow clone; fixture commit fetched), all exit 0 on re-run. `check:system-context-census` was a real red (the new `isSystem` read had no row) fixed by the row-17 edit. `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config packages/plugins/plugin-approvals` exit 0; `check-nul-bytes` exit 0.

Not run locally: `test:repo` (CI Test Core); full dogfood (no `!`, no `(narrowing)` arm).
</details>
